title: Enterprise Cloud SaaS Subscription Agreement
description: Cloud software subscription with index-linked price adjustments, 90 days termination notice, and New York governing law.

payment_terms.quote: Invoices shall be paid within sixty (60) days of receipt by Subscriber's accounts payable department.

price_adjustment.quote: After the first year, annual subscription charges are subject to an index-linked adjustment pegged to the Consumer Price Index (CPI), capped at 5% annually.

contract_term.quote: This subscription has an initial term of 24 months commencing on March 1, 2024.

auto_renewal.quote: The subscription shall automatically renew for consecutive 12-month periods unless terminated in accordance with Section 4.

termination_notice.quote: Either party may elect non-renewal or termination upon ninety (90) days prior written notice before the expiration of the current term.

liability_cap.quote: The total aggregate liability of either party for all claims arising out of this Agreement shall not exceed $2,500,000 USD.

governing_law.quote: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, excluding its conflicts of law rules.

volume_commitment.quote: Subscriber agrees to maintain a minimum spend of $120,000 USD per contract year across all operational subsidiaries.
